name: CytoNorm
description: Batch normalisation for cytometry: per-batch quantiles of the batch controls, a monotone spline onto their average, applied to every cell. Rust port of cytonormpy as configured for the CYTOSHRINK runs.

properties.name: cluster
properties.description: Number of FlowSOM clusters. This operator does not cluster: clustering is its own step. Add a FlowSOM step upstream (flowsom_rust_operator, or the R flowsom_operator), project its metacluster column, and name that factor in cluster_factor. 1 is CytoNorm without clustering, which is a legitimate configuration.

properties.name: number_of_cells
properties.description: Reference cells sampled per batch, cluster and channel to fit the quantiles; 0 uses every reference cell. CytoNorm subsamples for training too, and this is what keeps the memory booking fixed.

properties.name: n_quantiles
properties.description: Number of quantiles. 99 is the setting the reference runs use; cytonormpy's notebook default is 101.

properties.name: min_cells
properties.description: Reference cells a batch and cluster needs before a spline is fitted at all. Below it the data is passed through unchanged.

properties.name: seed
properties.description: Seed for the reference subsample, so a fit is repeatable.

properties.name: batch_factor
properties.description: Column factor holding the batch. Empty uses the first colour factor.

properties.name: type_factor
properties.description: Column factor holding the type. Empty uses the first label factor.

properties.name: reference_value
properties.description: Value in the type factor that marks a batch control. The R operator uses Train.

properties.name: cluster_factor
properties.description: Column factor holding a cluster label per cell, normally the metacluster_id from a FlowSOM step. A spline is then fitted per batch, cluster and channel. Empty normalises with a single cluster.

properties.name: collect_max_cells
properties.description: Cells above which the result is streamed rather than buffered; 0 always streams.

metaFactors.name: Cell
metaFactors.description: Cell or event identifier, one per column, together with the batch and the type.

metaFactors.name: Batch
metaFactors.description: Which batch each cell belongs to. Projected as a colour, as the R CytoNorm operator does, or named in the batch_factor property.

metaFactors.name: Type
metaFactors.description: Which cells are batch controls: the value in reference_value (default Train) marks them. Projected as a label, or named in type_factor.

metaFactors.name: Measurement
metaFactors.description: Values to normalise, usually already arcsinh transformed.
